title: Arrow of Lightning

sources.title: Arrow of Lightning
markers: * Deals {{InfoBlob|Weapon Damage}} and explodes in a bolt of lightning. dealing an additional {{DamageText|2d4|Lightning|drs=t}} damage.

summary: Weapon damage plus 2d4 Lightning. DC 12 Dexterity negates the extra Lightning damage. The item lists a 7 ft-radius effect. The shared arrow rules describe damage as applying to the target rather than nearby creatures.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Weapon damage plus 2d4 Lightning. DC 12 Dexterity negates the extra Lightning damage. The item lists a 7 ft-radius effect. The shared arrow rules describe damage as applying to the target rather than nearby creatures.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Use against a target vulnerable to Lightning.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
